market.what: Liquid and solid H2S scavengers (triazine ~55%), oil and gas, world
market.method: Avg of MarketsandMarkets $388M, Polaris $383M, SkyQuest $780M; $1.8B outlier dropped; no bottom-up found

value.logic: Triazine uses only ~0.8-0.96 lb H2S/gal; 40% less chemical x $0.52B = $0.2B; + no dithiazine/scale downtime: SLB North Sea case +260k BOE, >$21M in 1 yr; x ~10 such fields (est.) = $0.2B
value.revenue_logic: ~2.5% share of a ~$0.6B yr-7 market via blenders/distributors = ~$15M; take $12M
value.margin_logic: Specialty liquid sold at premium per lb H2S; raw materials must stay near triazine cost ($2-5/kg)

trend.drivers: Souring shale and offshore fields; refinery catalyst protection; dithiazine disposal cost; non-triazine growing 2-3x market rate

competition.notes: Crowded with mid-size chemical firms launching non-triazine grades (Clariant, Vink MBO, ICC 2025). No venture-backed molecule startup found. Streamline Series C 2022 (Kayne Anderson, amount not disclosed)

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom (aldehyde-free or metal-carboxylate scavenger), 3 variants
lab.test: Gas sparge/bubble-tower breakthrough vs MEA-triazine (lb H2S/gal); H2S in liquid by ASTM D5705/D7621; solids and calcite scale tests with field brine; needs an H2S-rated lab (e.g. Intertek, SwRI)
lab.logic: Synth 5-6 wk, $15k; H2S rig and scale tests 5-6 wk, ~$25k (est., H2S safety adds cost)

sale.gates: TSCA PMN/REACH for a new molecule; field trial 3-6 mo with operator via distributor; HOCNF if North Sea
